paper_title: A Telescope Search for Decaying Relic Axions
coupling_convention: dimensionless xi = (4/3)(E/N - 1.92), the paper's two-photon coupling parameter (NOT converted to g_agamma in GeV^-1)
notes: Telescope search for optical line emission from two-photon decay of thermal relic axions in galaxy clusters Abell 2667 and Abell 2390 using the VLT VIMOS IFU. New 95% CL upper limits on the model-independent two-photon coupling parameter xi in the mass window 4.5-7.7 eV, taken from Table I (limits derived directly from sky-subtracted flux; Table II cross-correlation limits are ~1.5x weaker). Values are the raw dimensionless xi from the paper; conversion to g_agamma [GeV^-1] requires g = (alpha/2pi)(3 xi/4)/f_a with f_a set by m_a. Limits assume thermal freeze-out relic abundance Omega_a h^2 = m_a,eV/130 and cluster axion mass fraction x_a = Omega_a/Omega_m (cosmological abundance assumption, not a local halo DM density). Masses near 5.43 eV and 4.83 eV (night-sky lines at 5577 A and 6300 A) are excluded from useful limits.
